description: Renders text with every occurrence of a search term wrapped in <mark class="tm-highlighted-text__match">, so a reader of a combobox row sees WHERE the term hit instead of re-reading the row. It renders a FRAGMENT — no wrapper element — because the call sites are option rows, table cells and picker lines that already own their box and their typography; the rendered text is exactly the text that was passed in, so a copy/paste and the accessible name both get the original string. The query is matched LITERALLY, never as a regular expression (a metacharacter matches itself instead of throwing or matching everything), case-insensitively by default and — unless AccentInsensitive is off — ignoring diacritics on BOTH sides, so "usti" finds "Ústí" and the marked run is the original accented text. A null, empty or whitespace-only query renders the text unchanged, which makes the component safe to render while the user is still typing.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text to render. Rendered as text — never interpreted as markup, so a host value containing < or & is shown, not executed.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The term to highlight, matched literally. Null, empty or whitespace-only means 'no match' and the text renders unchanged; leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before matching, so a trailing space in a live filter does not stop the highlight.

parameters.name: CaseSensitive
parameters.description: When true, casing matters. Default false — a search box that required the exact casing of the data would be unusable.

parameters.name: AccentInsensitive
parameters.description: When true (the default), diacritics are ignored on both sides: "usti" matches "Ústí" and "Ústí" matches "Usti". The marked run is always the original text. Turn it off when the distinction between "s" and "š" carries meaning for the host's data.

parameters.name: MatchClass
parameters.description: Extra class(es) added to every <mark>, on top of the component's own tm-highlighted-text__match — for a host that wants a different tone inside its own row.

notes: A presentation detail of a search, not a live region: it never announces anything. The combobox that owns the list already announces the search state, and a per-row announcement would be noise. The component is used by TmMultiSelect, TmFilterableDropdown, TmEntityPicker and TmUserPicker behind their opt-in HighlightMatches parameter.
